title: Ladder 15 · Quis fēcit? (Who did it?)
summary: Friday finale: the coffee machine burned after Thursday's party; Gaius forbids anyone to go home until someone reveals the blame, everyone suspects everyone, and Quintus reads Tullia's minutes to find the culprit: Gaius's own rule (and Monday's password).
